item.title: V8 Array Iterator Maglev Type Confusion — addrof/fakeobj Primitives (CVE-2026-14431)
item.description: High severity (CVSS 8.8) — binary · CVE-2026-14431. Affects: V8 JavaScript engine (Google Chrome and other Chromium-based browsers). Tags: v8, javascript-engine, chromium, maglev, type-confusion, array-iterator, cwe-843, sandboxed-read-write, memory-corruption.
